text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS.

For Kestrel Insurance, I built an end-to-end test suite for their broker quoting flow that runs on every pull request. It covered 160 tests and helped reduce release regressions from 6 a quarter to 1.

For your WordPress template challenge, I’d approach this as a practical systems problem: identify the cleanest way to swap the HTML template at scale across those existing URL paths without repeated manual edits. I’d be glad to help you think through the best implementation path and then build it carefully.
